releaseStrategy: Reviewed batches; never bulk-publish unreviewed candidates to meet the ceiling.
difficultyPolicy: Estimate difficulty for general adult players. Easy means approachable with plausible choices; do not relabel specialist facts to meet a quota. Open-answer letter games may feel harder.
coveragePolicy: Prioritize distinct answers in underfilled category/letter pairs where natural, worthwhile questions exist. The 100000 ceiling cannot meet every pair in the current categories.
checks: Verify each new fact against a supporting source.
Prefer primary institutional references and stable historical facts.
Use original wording, a concise explanation and a direct source link.
Check earlier questions and explanations for semantic duplicates.
Use four plausible, distinct choices with one unambiguous correct answer.
Preserve all published question IDs, category IDs and shared-round behavior.
Validate offline caching, counts, letter games, mix capacity, browsing and saved progress.
